basic_info.description: Welcome to this stylish and versatile tri-level loft in the heart of South Beach. Designed with flexibility and function in mind, this light-filled home features a spacious chef’s kitchen with skylights, a cozy wood-burning fireplace, and a private balcony—perfect for morning coffee or evening wind-downs. The unique layout offers endless possibilities: an enclosed bedroom on the entry level, open-concept living and kitchen space on the second, and a lofted upper level ideal for a home office, guest space, or creative retreat. Additional features include in-unit laundry and secure 1- car garage parking. Enjoy unbeatable access to the best of San Francisco—just moments from the Financial District, SF MoMA, Oracle Park, the Embarcadero, Yerba Buena Gardens, and more. With easy connections to 101, the Bay Bridge, and public transit, this is city living at its most convenient.
